refinement_summary: Closed a HIGH-severity API-contract gap flagged by the QA iteration-3 review. The bulk-pricing design (TDD Delta D3/D4/D6) validated each line item's finiteness but never re-validated the running aggregate total. Up to MAX_BULK_ITEMS=50 individually-finite line items can sum past Number.MAX_VALUE to Infinity, which +(Infinity).toFixed(2) serializes as JSON null with a 200 - contradicting the design's own stated Q2 invariant ('the bulk sum can never be a nonsensical null/Infinity'). Corrections: added decision Q2a (aggregate finite-total invariant -> 400 { error: 'total is too large' }); updated the D4 handler pseudocode with the in-loop accumulator guard; added a D6 worked example; added a D9 overflow test case (#9); added a HIGH-severity D10 risk row; updated the D7 input-handling note; and added the corresponding error line + behavior note in technical/API_CONTRACTS.md section 3.
